## 98e86aae9095

**Plausible shortcut not challenged by the distribution:** “after reading the
bottom-left key, select the only/topmost component of that color,” rather than
selecting the **largest** key-colored component. Every canonical example has only
one key-colored object after removing the key marker, and a 600-scene generated
census likewise found exactly one key-colored component in every scene.

Exact disagreeing input (`1` is the first transform code and `5` is the key):

```text
1000000000
0000000000
0500000000
0000050000
0000055000
0000005000
0000000000
5000000000
```

A topmost/first-component shortcut chooses the singleton and returns `[[5]]`.
The Racket authority chooses the larger four-cell component and applies code 1,
returning:

```text
055
550
```

The authoritative execution is retained in `checks/audit_counterexamples.json`.
The current generator never emits multiple components of the key color, so it
cannot refute this shortcut.

**Additional reproduced contract issue:** declared axes `shape`, `sequence`, and
`palette_kind` are inert. For seed 17/sample 0/medium, boundary-distinct values
for each axis produced byte-identical grids (same SHA-256), and an unknown
override key was accepted. See `checks/audit_generator_findings.json`.

## 98e86aae9095

**Reproduced validator/authority defect on unchanged source**
`38b08d299c99d2f3df002e680b83e72731535f54756efea1bc2df6638ad9d30d`.
Calling the advertised degenerate texture `texture="no_shape"` returns an input
for which `self_check` reports `[]`, although the bottom-left key color has no
selectable object. Executing the canonical Racket authority on that accepted
input fails with `hash-ref: contract violation ... given: #f ... 'bbox` when it
tries to crop the nonexistent target. This is stronger than a merely narrow
distribution: the validator accepts an input on which label generation is not
defined.

The same reproduction confirms two previously unresolved contract/teaching
issues. Boundary-distinct values for declared axes `shape`, `sequence`, and
`palette_kind` produce byte-identical grids for seed 17/sample 0/medium, and an
unknown override is accepted and ignored. A 600-draw medium census also found
exactly one post-marker component of the key color in every input, so the
canonical "largest key-color component" choice is never distinguished from
"the only key-color component" in that sample.

`checks/audit/98e86aae9095/reproduction.json`. Executable probe and receipt:
`checks/audit/98e86aae9095/reproduce.py`,
`checks/audit/98e86aae9095/command.log`, and
`checks/audit/98e86aae9095/command.exit` (0). No audited source was changed.
